name: icontk
description: High performance Rust CLI and TypeScript API for icon set generation, format conversion, and AI icon synthesis

scripts.build: bun x @napi-rs/cli build --platform --release && bun build index.ts --outfile index.js --target node && bun build cli.ts --outfile cli.js --target node && bun x tsc index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --target es2022 --module esnext --types @types/bun
